title: "Bases for U-2 Operations in the Middle East, 1956" – Wiesbaden and Adana (p. 113)
description: Small shaded map titled "Bases for U-2 Operations in the Middle East, 1956" showing Europe, the Mediterranean Sea and Turkey, with Wiesbaden, West Germany and Adana, Turkey marked. Includes North Atlantic Ocean and Black Sea labels and a "Secret NOFORN" marking. The text describes establishing Detachment B (cryptonym KWCORK) at Incirlik airbase near Adana in 1956 during the Suez Crisis.
